verdict.rationale: One-step Jupyter or IDE access is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents downloading a kubeconfig to use kubectl against CKS clusters. That is a general cluster-access building block, not a one-step Jupyter launch or a VS Code/Cursor remote connection, and nothing in the pack mentions Jupyter, notebooks, SSH, or IDE integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open Jupyter or connect my IDE (VS Code/Cursor) to the instance in one step
